product_overview: Kilusi Bill is a customer self-service portal for ISP subscribers to manage access, billing, device settings, support requests, and referrals. It also provides a dashboard view of account status, service details, and active announcements.
core_goals: Log in to the customer portal using phone number OTP or a login token
View account status, package details, billing summary, and connected device information
Inspect invoice details and payment status
Manage WiFi settings and view connected devices

features.name: Customer Login
features.description: Allows customers to authenticate with phone number and OTP, or by opening a token-based login link.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/login -> Enter phone number -> Request OTP -> Receive OTP code -> Enter OTP code -> Submit verification -> See customer dashboard
Navigate to /customer/login -> Enter an invalid phone number or OTP -> Submit verification -> See an error message
Navigate to /customer/login/[token] -> Open the token login link -> See the customer dashboard

features.name: Customer Dashboard
features.description: Shows the main portal with account status, package information, billing summary, connected devices, announcements, and quick access actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/portal -> View account status, package details, billing summary, connected devices count, and active broadcast messages
Navigate to /customer/portal -> Switch to another linked account -> See the dashboard refresh with the selected account's details
Navigate to /customer/portal -> Choose a quick action for billing, device settings, WiFi settings, or support -> Open the selected section

features.name: Customer Billing
features.description: Lets customers review unpaid and overdue invoices as well as payment history.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/billing -> View the invoices list under Tagihan -> Review invoice numbers, amounts, due dates, and status badges
Navigate to /customer/billing -> Switch to Riwayat Pembayaran -> View payment history with date, amount, and payment method
Navigate to /customer/billing -> Select an invoice -> Open the invoice detail page

features.name: Invoice Detail
features.description: Displays a single invoice with its line items, totals, due date, payment status, and payment action for unpaid invoices.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/billing/invoices/[id] -> View invoice items, totals, due date, and payment status
Navigate to /customer/billing/invoices/[id] -> Open an unpaid invoice -> Proceed to pay the invoice -> See the payment success page

features.name: Device Settings
features.description: Lets customers inspect their SSID, WiFi password, connected devices, and restart the device.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/settings/device -> View current SSID, hidden WiFi password, and connected devices list
Navigate to /customer/settings/device -> Reveal the WiFi password -> Hide the WiFi password again
Navigate to /customer/settings/device -> Restart the device -> See the reboot action complete

features.name: WiFi Settings
features.description: Allows customers to change the SSID and WiFi password for their connection.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/settings/wifi -> View current SSID and password -> Enter a new SSID -> Update the SSID -> See a success notification
Navigate to /customer/settings/wifi -> View current SSID and password -> Enter a new password -> Update the password -> See a success notification

features.name: Profile Settings
features.description: Allows customers to view and edit their profile information.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/settings/profile -> View customer name, email, phone, and address
Navigate to /customer/settings/profile -> Edit profile information -> Save changes -> See the updated profile information

features.name: Support Tickets
features.description: Provides a ticket list, ticket creation form, and ticket detail conversation view.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/support -> View existing support tickets and their status
Navigate to /customer/support/tickets/new -> Fill in subject, description, category, and priority -> Submit the ticket -> Return to the support area
Navigate to /customer/support/tickets/[id] -> View ticket details and message thread -> Add a new message -> See the message appear in the thread

features.name: Referral Program
features.description: Shows the customer's referral code, referral history, rewards, and sharing options.
user_flows: Navigate to /customer/referrals -> View personal referral code, referral history, and earned rewards
Navigate to /customer/referrals -> Copy or share the referral link

routes.description: Customer login page with phone/OTP authentication
Customer dashboard portal showing status, billing summary, connected devices count
Customer billing page with invoices and payment history tabs
Device settings page showing SSID, WiFi password, connected devices
WiFi settings page for SSID and password management

features.name: Customer Login
features.description: Customer authentication via phone number and OTP, or token-based login
user_interactions: Enter phone number in login form
Click "Kirim OTP" button to receive OTP code
Enter OTP code received via WhatsApp/SMS
Click "Verifikasi" button to authenticate
See error message on invalid OTP or phone number
Alternatively, authenticate via token URL /customer/login/[token]

features.name: Customer Dashboard
features.description: Main portal dashboard showing account status, billing summary, online devices, and quick actions
user_interactions: View account status (active/inactive/suspended)
View current package name and price
View billing summary with unpaid invoices count
View connected devices count from GenieACS
Click quick action buttons for billing, settings, support
Switch between linked accounts

features.name: Customer Billing
features.description: View invoices and payment history with tab navigation
user_interactions: Switch between "Tagihan" (invoices) and "Riwayat Pembayaran" (payment history) tabs
View list of invoices with status badges (unpaid/overdue/paid)
Click on invoice to see detail
View payment history with date, amount, and method

features.name: Invoice Detail
features.description: Detailed invoice view with line items and payment info
user_interactions: View invoice details including items, amounts, due date
View payment status
Click pay button for unpaid invoices

features.name: Device Settings
features.description: View and manage connected device info including SSID, WiFi password, and connected devices list
user_interactions: View current SSID from database/GenieACS
View WiFi password (hidden as asterisks, click to reveal)
View list of connected devices from GenieACS LAN hosts
Click eye icon to reveal/hide WiFi password
Click reboot button to restart device

features.name: WiFi Settings
features.description: Change WiFi SSID and password with real-time updates to GenieACS and database
user_interactions: View current SSID and password
Enter new SSID in input field
Click update SSID button
Enter new password in input field
Click update password button
See success/error toast notifications

features.name: Profile Settings
features.description: View and edit customer profile information
user_interactions: View customer name, email, phone, address
Edit profile fields
Save changes

features.name: Support Tickets
features.description: Create and manage support tickets
user_interactions: View list of existing support tickets
Click "Buat Tiket Baru" button to create new ticket
Fill in subject, description, category, priority
Submit ticket
View ticket detail and add messages

features.name: Referral Program
features.description: View referral code and referral history, share referral link
user_interactions: View personal referral code
View referral history and earned rewards
Copy/share referral link

features.name: Broadcast Messages
features.description: View active broadcast messages from admin (info, maintenance, disruption notices)
user_interactions: View broadcast messages on dashboard
Dismiss notification

features.name: System Status
features.description: Check system health and service status
user_interactions: View system status indicators

known_limitations.issue: Customer portal uses localStorage for auth tokens which may not persist across sessions
known_limitations.impact: Customer may need to re-login if localStorage is cleared

known_limitations.issue: Some API endpoints return nested data structures that require careful parsing
known_limitations.impact: Inconsistent data access patterns may cause UI rendering issues
